title: AccessControlUpsertRequest
description: Payload for creating or updating an access control.

name.description: Localized name as a map of language codes to text.

description.description: Localized description as a map of language codes to text.

scopes.description: Scope codes for this access control. Must not be empty.

domains.description: Domain identifiers for the access control.

restrictedTo.description:
Restricts the type of group this access control can be assigned to.
* `CUSTOMER` - the access control can be assigned only to groups of `CUSTOMER` user type.
* `EMPLOYEE` - the access control can be assigned only to groups of `EMPLOYEE` user type.

If this property is not present, the access control can be assigned to any group regardless of its user type.

**Note**: This property is immutable. It can only be set when the access control is created and cannot be changed afterwards.

metadata.description: Metadata for optimistic locking on updates. Only `version` is supported.

version.description: Document version. When provided on update, must match the stored version.
